gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: Could you pass me ___ salt, please?
gaps.explanation: 'The salt' — both speakers know which one (on the table).

gaps.sentence: ___ noise pollution in cities is getting worse.
gaps.explanation: 'Noise pollution' as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).

gaps.sentence: ___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
She earns fifty pounds ___ hour as a consultant.
gaps.explanation: 'An hour' — the 'h' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound.
